::api-operation{method="GET" path="/v1/businesses/{biz}/invoices/{inv}/refund_gateway_account"}
#docs
`gateway_account` is null when no payment resolves to an account, or when payments went through more than one account. Read its balance with `GET /v1/businesses/{biz}/gateway_accounts/{gwa}/balance`.

## Path parameters

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `biz` | `string` | **yes** | Business id (biz_…) |
| `inv` | `string` | **yes** | The invoice's id (inv_…). |

## Response

| Field | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `object` | `string` | The object type; always `refund_gateway_account`. One of `refund_gateway_account`. |
| `invoice` | `string` | The invoice's id (inv_…). |
| `gateway_account` | `object` | The gateway account. |

## Status codes

| Status | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `200` | Refund gateway account |
| `404` | Invoice not found |

#request
```bash [Request]
curl "$TMBILLING_URL/v1/businesses/biz_XXXXXXXXXXXX01/invoices/inv_XXXXXXXXXXXX01/refund_gateway_account" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TMBILLING_API_KEY"
```

#response

```json [200 OK]
{

  "invoice": "inv_XXXXXXXXXXXX01",
  "gateway_account": {
    "id": "gwa_XXXXXXXXXXXX01",
    "label": "Example",
    "gateway_key": "paypal"
  }
}
```
